name: @ai-ecoverse/slicc-cdp
description: SLICC's CDP layer: client, browser API, transports, HAR, and ARIA snapshot

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-wasip1 -p playwright-cli -p curlwright && mkdir -p bin && cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/playwright-cli.wasm bin/playwright-cli.wasm && cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/curlwright.wasm bin/curlwright.wasm
scripts.typecheck: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/cdp-client.js && node --check src/connect.js
scripts.test:integration: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build -p playwright-cli -p curlwright && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build --target wasm32-wasip1 -p playwright-cli -p curlwright && npx playwright-core install chromium && node --test --test-timeout=180000 test/integration/chromium.test.mjs
